howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Your Journey to a Healthy Harvest

step1.title: Capture the Symptom
step1.description: Open the New Scan tool and take a clear, well-lit photo of a maize leaf. Ensure the leaf is centered and the spots are in focus.
step1.tip: Avoid shadows and keep the phone parallel to the leaf.

step2.title: AI & Climate Analysis
step2.description: The app simultaneously runs two processes: CNN Analysis inspects the leaf for chlorosis (yellowing) and necrosis (browning). Weather Fetching pulls live temperature and humidity data from your farm's GPS coordinates.

step3.title: Integrated Results
step3.description: Within 3 seconds, you receive a Fusion Report showing your Severity Level (e.g., Moderate) and your Spread Risk (e.g., High Risk due to upcoming rain).

step4.title: Expert Recommendations
step4.description: Based on the results, the app provides a tailored IPM Plan. For Early/Moderate: apply specific pesticide and monitor neighbors. For Severe: uproot and burn infected plants immediately.

step5.title: Save & Track
step5.description: The scan is automatically saved to your History. Revisit this scan later to see if your field is getting healthier after following the advice.

q1.question: What is MLN and why is it dangerous?
q1.answer: Maize Lethal Necrosis (MLN) is a severe disease caused by the combination of two viruses. It causes maize leaves to turn yellow (chlorosis) and eventually dry up (necrosis). It is dangerous because it spreads rapidly via insects like thrips and beetles, and if left untreated, it can destroy 100% of your harvest in a single season.

q2.question: How does IkigoriSmart know how "severe" the disease is?
q2.answer: The app uses an advanced Artificial Intelligence model (CNN) that has been trained on thousands of maize leaf images. It "looks" at the percentage of yellow and brown spots on your leaf. Early: Small spots, but the plant is still growing. Moderate: Large yellow patches and some drying. Severe: The leaf is mostly dead/brown, and the plant's life is at risk.

q3.question: Why does the app ask for my GPS and Weather data?
q3.answer: MLN spread is highly dependent on the environment. Warm temperatures and high humidity make it easier for the insects that carry the virus to multiply. By "fusing" your leaf scan with your local weather data, IkigoriSmart can tell you not just if your plant is sick, but how likely it is that the disease will spread to the rest of your field or your neighbors.

q4.question: What should I do if my result is "Severe"?
q4.answer: If the app detects a severe infection, the safest action is usually to uproot the infected plants immediately and burn them far from your field. This prevents the virus from spreading to healthy plants. The app will provide specific "Immediate Actions" and "Chemical Options" based on the latest guidelines from the Rwanda Agriculture Board (RAB).

q5.question: Can I use the app without an internet connection?
q5.answer: You can take photos and save them to the app while offline in the field. However, to get the AI Diagnosis and Live Weather Risk, you will need a brief internet connection (3G/4G or Wi-Fi) so the app can communicate with our cloud servers and weather providers.
